events.body:
## Context

`src/index.py` serves the profile page for `/zerocool/`, `/index` and `/404.html`. On `/zerocool/`, `public/profile.html` fetches the relative `profiles/zerocool.json`, which resolves to `/zerocool/profiles/...` and 404s, so a valid profile shows "Profile not found". `/index` renders "@undefined". `RESERVED_PATHS` lacks `index` and `404.html`, though `scripts/actions/add-profile.mjs` claims to mirror it.

## What to do

1. Use absolute paths in `profile.html` (`/profiles/...json`, `href="/"`).
2. Add `index` and `404.html` to `RESERVED_PATHS`.
3. Guard `renderProfile` against non-object JSON. Optional: redirect `/<user>/` to `/<user>`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `/blt_demo/` renders the demo profile
- [ ] `/index` shows not-found
- [ ] Both reserved lists match

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-profiles && npx wrangler dev   # open /blt_demo, /blt_demo/ and /index
```
